about_head: From software development to AI security
about: I lead security for the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center in EMEA, working with delivery teams to review AI systems and address risks before deployment.

I started in software development and taught algorithms and data structures at Durham University, where I studied Computer Science. At AWS, I moved from DevOps into security, risk and compliance, then specialised in AI security.
My work includes threat modelling and security assessments of AI applications. I advise teams on data residency and retention, and review the permissions they give AI agents and tools.
Teaching has stayed part of my work. I run security workshops and mentor women moving into cloud and security. This guide shares the foundations I wish had been easier to find when I started.
